title: SQL Injection in Login Forms: A Practical Exploit Guide
content: This article demonstrates a SQL injection attack against a login form. We show how an attacker can bypass authentication using the classic ' OR '1'='1 payload, extract user credentials via UNION-based queries, and escalate to database administrator access. Included is a working proof-of-concept script in Python that automates the exploitation pipeline against a vulnerable test application. We also discuss mitigations: parameterized queries, input validation, and WAF rules.
